newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Monday.
"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning on lack of fresh factors. There was no fresh news and the market traded with a narrow range on some position adjustments," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting for Tuesday's release of the (U.S. March) factory orders data, for more clues to market direction," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday was unchanged from last Friday's 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent.
Tuesday/Wednesday and week-fixed were unchanged from Friday's common 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, nine-months unchanged at 6-1/8 6 percent and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/4 6-1/8 percent.
